study.question: Does explicit multiplicative modulation of compact count/freshness evidence by the existing grouped-history representation improve its predictive utility beyond a separable additive context branch and a same-capacity redundant-statistic replacement?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0006-groups_evidence concatenation reached AUC 0.6185907798, below g1-r0005-match_groups 0.6187998914; residual readout g0-r0007-residual_count_freshness reached 0.6197365168 versus count/presence 0.6195402718, presence/freshness 0.6188257999 and presence/presence 0.6186481041. Count and freshness simple effects at the full cell are 0.0009107169 and 0.0001962450; their difference-of-differences is only 0.0000185491. Full evidence also trails count/presence for history_1_16 (0.5742256382 vs 0.5747943885; 41805 impressions, 1444 positives), while leading for history_gt64 (0.6204181904 vs 0.6201318886; 3026583 impressions, 151372 positives). These are exploratory one-seed observations, not conditional-mechanism evidence. The parent correction is a function only of compact evidence. A bounded multiplicative head may let the same evidence have different effects with different grouped history contents; an equal-capacity separable additive head tests whether adding context capacity alone suffices.

nearest_work.difference: Retain original backbone, evidence definition, correction projection and zero readout allocation; append a 68->32 context projection and compare multiplicative versus separable additive correction. This is a readout modification, not a fresh input or longer-history result.

DIN computes target-dependent event activation and explicitly discusses intensity lost by normalized attention. Our inherited reference uses softmax and is not an exact DIN reproduction. This test keeps deterministic category/brand match-group pooling and operates on compact summary corrections without a neural event scorer.

nearest_work.source_ref: craft-paper-v1; arxiv:2609.01655v1 section 4.2 equations 7-9, archived lines 165-189; content-sha256:730eadf916992085f31c29bc01ba0b3c476dece6d9b90c7d8ed8c576136f0b6e
nearest_work.difference: CRAFT uses reliability-pooled non-sequential context to transport intent/sequence states across depth, with displacement and memory paths. Here a single grouped-history summary modulates an evidence correction through 1+tanh(W context); no reliability pooling, transport stack, memory anchor, bridge or distillation. Conditional multiplication is prior art; global novelty is unverified.

The author README establishes category/brand/action histories without item identity; preserve that field boundary. Publisher full text is unavailable in the granted source snapshot; no detailed DMR equivalence or priority claim.

inherited_components: Reviewed all 13 supplied trajectories: static, pooled, DIN-style, compact evidence, match groups, four concatenation cells including null/regressive branches, and four residual count/freshness cells. All recorded executions succeeded; regressions are scientific outcomes, not missing execution.
Frozen match-group backbone and initialization order, including unused attention allocation; no checkpoint reuse
Exact supplied-event count/freshness extraction: 16 overlapping group-action log-counts scaled by log(129), 16 mean exp(-age/86400) values, zero empty cells; fixed missing-value and padding semantics
Parent bias-free evidence correction modules 32->32->1 and zero readout initialization; all modules train from scratch
study.proposed_difference: For e in R32 and context h=[four d=16 match-group means,N,C,B,J] in R68, form a=ReLU(W_e e), m=tanh(W_h h). Multiplicative correction is w^T[a*(1+m)]; additive control is w^T[a+m], exactly separable at fixed representations. Cross this with detailed e versus N,C,B,J repeated eight times. All four use identical 3232 correction parameters, allocation order, and computation of both fusion expressions. Backbone remains 17136931 parameters, so expected total is 17140163, 2176 above parent. Zero final w yields the same initial backbone logits in every cell. Both forms give zero correction for fully empty histories. Only candidate modules and proposal are written; raw data, scorer and runtime remain host-owned.
predictions: Predeclared primary contrasts: Delta_D=AUC(conditioned_evidence)-AUC(additive_evidence); Delta_R=AUC(conditioned_redundant)-AUC(additive_redundant); interaction I=Delta_D-Delta_R. Evidence-specific conditioning predicts Delta_D>0 and I>0, with conditioned_evidence also exceeding incumbent g0-r0007-residual_count_freshness (0.6197365168). Compute both evidence simple effects too; report all cells, including losses.

Secondary unweighted Logloss, parameters, measured wall/train time, allocated GPU seconds if host supplies them, memory, inference examples/s, batch p50/p95 latency. No equal-compute efficiency claim from equal recipe alone. At comparable AUC, prefer lower measured cost; do not silently trade Logloss for AUC.

Predeclared descriptive slices reuse host history_1_16, history_17_64, history_gt64, empty_history and category_match_present/absent bins with sample/positive/negative counts. Test whether the short-history loss persists; no significance or confirmatory subgroup claim from these reused validation slices.

Head finite-difference interaction is approximately zero in additive cells, and may be nonzero in multiplicative cells; it is a structural implementation diagnostic, not performance evidence. Both cells must have finite logits, zero empty correction, zero-length equivalence, padding invariance and count identities. At most 64 label-free diagnostic scalars on the host fixed 512-impression batch.
falsifiers: If conditioned_evidence does not beat both additive_evidence and the prior incumbent, incremental utility of this conditioning implementation is unsupported even if it beats a redundant cell.
If I<=0 or the redundant conditioning effect matches/exceeds Delta_D, a general context/readout or optimization explanation remains sufficient; no evidence-specific complementarity claim.
If only short or sparse slices improve but population AUC falls, retain as a negative population result; do not change evaluation weighting.

Nonfinite logits, nonzero empty correction, padding dependence, violated count identities or additive head interaction above floating-point tolerance invalidate implementation interpretation; preserve failed costs and require a corrected proposal before execution.
If three paired seeds later disagree in direction or effects are dominated by seed variation, retain a preliminary/null interpretation; one successful cell cannot establish mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Equal parameter counts do not equalize effective rank, feature scaling, optimization or hypothesis classes.
Redundant slots repeat only N,C,B,J and have lower information rank; they are a capacity/readout control, not a distribution-matched conditional randomization.
Shared learned embeddings and backbone co-adapt. Exact head separability is conditional on fixed representations; outcome differences do not establish event-level causal mechanisms.
A single paired seed and adaptively selected validation outcomes remain preliminary; cluster bootstrap is unavailable in this coding interface.

The earlier residual gain could reflect initialization/optimization rather than recovered information; successful residual and unsuccessful concatenation differ in parameter allocation and path structure.
Occupancy, action mix, and continuous freshness remain coupled in detailed inputs; this factorial tests detailed evidence as a block and does not independently identify freshness or a specific group.

Snapshot as-of dates are undocumented; fixed publisher snapshots are a benchmark assumption, not verified production point-in-time data. Hash collisions, 128-event truncation and mostly long histories limit generalization.
